catalogue.comment:
PHASE 0.1 GREY KNIGHTS. All 13 source datasheets are selectable. All four Leaders consume Leader capacity and use the standard attachment primitive, attaching to either GREY KNIGHT TERMINATOR or GREY KNIGHT PALADIN. Grey Knight Chaplain is Rare. Variable-size units are represented at minimum legal size until model-count selection enters scope.

LOADOUT + ADDITIONAL COPY COST PASS
Loadouts implemented for all native Grey Knights units. All native non-Rare Other units, including Interceptors, use the soft 1/2/3 Additional Copy Cost system.

VARIABLE UNIT SIZE PASS
Variable-size squads now use the canonical minimum-size-root + optional-extra-model pattern. Strike Squad is 3+1, Purifiers 2+1, Purgation Squad 2+1, and Interceptors 2+1. Extra models carry their own cost and loadout subtree where loadouts are implemented. Interceptor loadout remains deferred.

PURIFIER / INTERCEPTOR SPECIALIST CLEANUP
Purifier 2 now advertises only heavy weapons. Interceptor loadout is implemented: Justicar, heavy-only model 2, and optional normal model 3 with paid Force Stave.

STRIKE SQUAD SPECIALIST CLEANUP
Grey Knight Strike Squad model 3 is now presented only as the dedicated heavy-weapons model (Psycannon / Psilencer / Incinerator). Ordinary Storm Bolter alternatives are intentionally omitted.

CONSTRUCTIVE ERROR MIGRATION
Grey Knights now use Game System revision 11. Additional Copy Costs, mandatory Leader attachments, Terminator/Paladin host Leader limits, and the Grey Knight Chaplain Rare restriction use constructive player-facing validation. Existing loadouts, variable-size structures, points, Leader Capacity semantics, and Additional Copy Costs arithmetic are otherwise unchanged.
